info.title: Salesforce
info.description: Authentication: OAuth 2.0 (client credentials grant). Salesforce is a cloud-based CRM platform. This spec covers the core REST API's standard-object surface (Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead, and any other standard or custom object) via the generic sobjects endpoints, plus SOQL/SOSL query and search.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 11 of 21 upstream operations covering CRUD on standard and custom objects via the generic sobjects endpoints (list, describe, create, retrieve, update, delete, upsert by external ID) plus SOQL query/queryAll and SOSL search. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.
